name: Smart Search's saved queries on a phone, as viewer at 390x844 with touch and the mobile layout: the tabs, the Saved tab and the Search tab's actions (Save, Save as new, Share) within the screen, the tabs, filters, the row actions and the names touch-sized (40 px), and the save dialog within the screen with its fields and buttons. Screenshots smartsearch-saved-phone*.png. Run after smartsearch-saved-desktop.json (its queries).

steps.name: page helpers (viewer)
steps.initScript:
window.__ss = {
  root: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted] .jfss-search')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0) || null,
  q: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? r.querySelector(s) : null; },
  all: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? [...r.querySelectorAll(s)] : []; },
  set: (s, v) => { const e = window.__ss.q(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; },
  ready: () => !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-scope') && !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-search-button'),
  done: () => { const c = window.__ss.q('.jfss-count'); const n = window.__ss.q('.jfss-notices'); if (c && c.textContent && !/Searching/.test(c.textContent)) return c.textContent; if (n && n.textContent) return n.textContent; return false; },
  ids: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-card, .jfss-row').map(x => x.getAttribute('data-id')),
  norm: (ids) => ids.map(i => String(i).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase()).sort().join(),
  noHScroll: () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && window.__ss.root().scrollWidth <= window.__ss.root().clientWidth + 1,
  box: (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; },
  api: async (method, path, body) => { const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(path), { method, headers: { 'X-Emby-Token': ApiClient.accessToken(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }); const t = await r.text(); return { status: r.status, body: t ? JSON.parse(t) : null }; },
  cleanup: async (prefix) => { const list = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Queries?scope=Mine&limit=500')).body.Items; let n = 0; for (const q of list) { if (q.Name.indexOf(prefix) === 0) { await window.__ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + q.Id); n++; } } return n; },
  dialog: () => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].filter(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); return d[d.length - 1] || null; },
  dbutton: (text) => { const d = window.__ss.dialog(); return d ? [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === text) || null : null; },
  rows: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-saved-row'),
  names: () => window.__ss.rows().map(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-saved-open').textContent),
  row: (name) => window.__ss.rows().find(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-saved-open').textContent === name) || null,
  action: (name, cls) => { const r = window.__ss.row(name); return r ? r.querySelector(cls) : null; },
  toast: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfss-toast')].map(t => t.textContent).join(' | '),
  runs: (id) => performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => e.name.indexOf('SmartSearch/Queries/' + id + '/Search') >= 0).length,
  searches: () => performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e => /SmartSearch\/Search$/.test(e.name)).length
};

steps.name: a query of viewer's to open
the phone list
steps.eval: ({ noHScroll: __ss.noHScroll(), tabs: __ss.all('[role="tab"]').map(__ss.box), filters: __ss.all('.jfss-filter').map(__ss.box), actions: __ss.all('.jfss-saved-action').filter(b => b.getClientRects().length > 0).map(__ss.box), names: __ss.all('.jfss-saved-open').map(__ss.box), rowsInside: __ss.rows().every(r => r.getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth + 1) })

steps.name: the dialog's size
steps.eval: (() => { const d = __ss.dialog(); const r = d.getBoundingClientRect(); return { left: r.left, right: r.right, width: innerWidth, fields: [...d.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].every(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().right <= innerWidth + 1), buttons: [...d.querySelectorAll('.jfss-actions button')].map(__ss.box) }; })()
